findings.title: Empty updateMany data throws and never bumps updatedAt
findings.body: In packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts line 1024 fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache calls SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {}) with empty data. Prisma updateMany requires non-empty data and throws a validation error for {}, so every cache warmup fails after fetching availability. Even if it did not throw, an empty update would not touch updatedAt, defeating the stated intent to update SelectedCalendar.updatedAt. Fix by passing explicit data like { updatedAt: new Date() }.

findings.title: Delete-cache success never refreshes cache status
findings.body: In packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx the deleteCacheMutation onSuccess only shows a toast and calls optional onSuccess prop, while disconnectMutation invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars and viewer.apps.integrations onSettled. After deleting cache the connectedCalendars query still holds the old cacheUpdatedAt, so the UI keeps showing the old Last updated timestamp unless the parent happens to refetch. Invalidate connectedCalendars on delete success/settled.

findings.title: Cache status includes expired entries
findings.body: In packages/features/calendar-cache/calendar-cache.repository.ts getCacheStatusByCredentialIds groups by credentialId with no expiresAt filter, while getCachedAvailability only returns rows with expiresAt >= now. The UI therefore shows Cache Status / Last updated even when all rows for that credential are expired and will never be used, misleading users and offering Delete cached data for dead data. Filter status query to non-expired rows.

findings.title: Throws generic Error instead of TRPCError
findings.body: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/deleteCache.handler.ts credential ownership failure throws new Error('Credential not found or access denied'). As a plain Error it surfaces as INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR 500 instead of NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN, client cannot distinguish auth failure, and it pollutes server error logs. Throw TRPCError with appropriate code like the rest of the codebase.

findings.title: BSD-only sed breaks script on Linux
findings.body: In scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh line 68 uses sed -i '' -E which is macOS BSD syntax. On GNU/Linux sed -i '' is parsed as an empty backup suffix plus a script file named '', so the GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL replacement fails and webhook local testing is broken on Linux. Use a portable update or OS-specific branch, and resolve ENV_FILE relative to script dir.

findings.title: Cache timestamp hardcoded to en-US
findings.body: In packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx the cache timestamp uses new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', ...) ignoring the user's locale from useLocale. Users in other locales see MM/DD/YYYY format inconsistent with the rest of the app. Pass the current locale instead of hardcoding en-US.
